preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the graph is between 1 and 216, inclusive.
The degree of each vertex is between 0 and n - 1, inclusive.
The XOR sum of adjacent vertices for each vertex is less than 216.

postconditions.description: The number of edges printed is equal to the actual number of edges in the graph.

postconditions.expression: all((0 <= a < n and 0 <= b < n and a != b) for a, b in edges)
postconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct vertices within the range of 0 to n - 1.

postconditions.expression: all(degreei == len([b for b in range(n) if a in edges and b in edges and a != b]) for i, (degreei, si) in enumerate(input_data))
postconditions.description: The degree of each vertex matches the number of edges connected to it as per the edges list.

postconditions.expression: all(si == sum([b for b in range(n) if a in edges and b in edges and a != b]) ^ sum([b for b in range(n) if a in edges and b in edges and a != b]) for i, (degreei, si) in enumerate(input_data))
postconditions.description: The XOR sum of adjacent vertices for each vertex matches the actual XOR sum as per the edges list.
